snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut - PC & PS5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863680/ZERO_PARADES/

https://www.playstation.com/en-gb/games/zero-parades-for-dead-spies/

ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut arrives across PC storefronts on October 1st, available as a free update to all owners of ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies. 

This definitive edition of our espionage RPG comes to PlayStation®5 (PS5®) on November 3rd. 

ZERO PARADES: Director’s Cut brings more story, scenery and mind-f*ckery to discover during your bid to reunite The Whole Sick Crew. Find out more about what's included here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2863680/view/678509959027097880
